name: Jergosh's Incinerate and Immolate and Archmage Arugal's Wrath and Curse reach 30 yards and need line of sight
contract: Ascension's kit spells for Jergosh the Invoker (11518) and Archmage Arugal (4275) have 100 yards or unlimited range in
Spell.dbc, and Arugal's two also ignore line of sight. Our tester saw Jergosh's Incinerate hit from any distance and Curse
of Arugal through a wall. Incinerate 2102540, Immolate 2102536, Wrath of Arugal 2102677 and Curse of Arugal 2102679 now
reach 30 yards (SpellRange 4) and need line of sight. The bosses' other spells keep their data.
